1.title: Amid Abuse Claims Against Max Miller, This Democrat Thinks He Can Win His Seat
1.summary: Brian Poindexter, an ironworker, is in the spotlight in Ohio’s 7th Congressional District, where Mr. Miller faces multiple calls to step aside.

2.title: Democrats Vow to Unite Behind Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, but Tensions Remain
2.summary: The party is racing to get behind Dr. Abdul El-Sayed after a poisonous Senate primary in Michigan, but some Democrats still have reservations.

3.title: Tacky, Rude and Beloved: Is an I-95 Landmark Worth Saving?
3.summary: South of the Border harks back to a different time in the South, before the region diversified and exploded in growth.

4.title: Yemen Teeters on Civil War as Regional Stability Hangs in the Balance
4.summary: While the Middle East waits to hear whether a deal can be reached to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the Yemeni government’s conflict with Iran-backed Houthi rebels escalated overnight.

5.title: As Thailand Gets Known for Mass Shootings, Fresh Pledges to Fix Gun Laws
5.summary: A rampage at a high school in Thailand on Friday was the latest episode of gun violence in a country that has grappled in recent years with several attacks.

6.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
6.summary: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from  Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.
